We provide robustness for digitalised organisations

Link Icon
Diamond
No

We ensure the resilience of the Internet across the Nordics and beyond by providing technical infrastructure, services, and knowledge. For more than 30 years, we have helped public and private organisations secure the digital foundations of society.

Working for the good of the internet

Netnod is a commercial company owned by a non-profit foundation. Our business activities enable us to fulfil our mission: protecting the core of the Internet and building a more robust and secure digital future. We reinvest our profits in infrastructure, technical expertise and collaboration with the Internet community to strengthen digital resilience in the Nordics and beyond.

 

We provide services at the core of the internet

IX
Internet Exchange
Join the largest IX in the Nordics and exchange traffic with networks across Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, Oslo, and beyond.
Transport
DWDM Transport
Get customised high-capacity transport deployed quickly between locations in the Nordics.
Security
Security services
Strengthen your operational resilience with customised security solutions, exercises, and robustness roadmaps.
DNS
DNS Services
Use Netnod’s world-leading platform for fully managed primary and secondary DNS services.
I-root
I-root
The root name servers are a critical part of the Internet’s infrastructure. Since 2000, Netnod has operated i.root-servers.net, the first root server to be located outside of the United States.
Netnod Time
Time Services
Ensure accurate, secure time with resilient NTP and high-precision PTP services.

Flexible interconnection across the Nordics

Connect and peer with networks across the Nordics through flexible interconnection options.
